## Overview

Ticker: UBER. Fiscal year ended 2025-12-31. Filings: 10-K 0001543151-26-000015; 10-Q 0001543151-26-000041; 8-K 0001543151-26-000039

## Market Positioning and Growth Outlook

Uber Technologies operates a technology platform connecting consumers with mobility, delivery, and freight services (“Uber,” 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 181). The company’s offerings include ridesharing, meal/grocery delivery, and connections for shippers and carriers ("Uber," 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, lines 181-182). Uber operates in over 70 countries, with a significant presence in the U.S., Canada, Latin America, Europe, and Asia Pacific (“Uber,” 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 182). The company reports results through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight ("Uber," 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 184).

Management highlights a focus on expanding supply in the Mobility segment, building momentum in Delivery, and deepening engagement across its platform (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, lines 7-9). They also emphasize translating growth into profitability with record operating income margins (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, line 9). The company acknowledges risks related to litigation and regulatory proceedings ("Uber," 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 147), competition (“Uber,” 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 148) and global economic conditions ("Uber," 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 165). Uber also notes the potential impact of cybersecurity incidents on its business (“Uber,” 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 169).

Insight: Delivery Gross Bookings grew 22% year-over-year, on a constant currency basis, primarily driven by an increase in Delivery Trip volumes (10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 776). <!-- claim:uber_insight_research -->

## Future Developments and Strategic Recommendations

Monitor Delivery Gross Bookings to assess continued momentum in that segment (“Uber,” 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 776). Track the expansion of supply within the Mobility segment and its impact on growth (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, lines 7-9). Monitor operating income margins to evaluate Uber’s progress in translating growth into profitability (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, line 9). Assess the impact of autonomous vehicle deployment on key metrics such as ride volume and cost structure (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, lines 7-8).

## Investment Recommendation

Uber demonstrates improving profitability alongside growth in its core segments. The company’s recent focus on expanding supply in Mobility and building momentum in Delivery is translating to financial results. A key indicator of this progress is the operating margin of 10.70% (OperatingIncomeLoss tag; 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). I recommend a Buy rating.
